Once Robin mentioned the livestock situation, I requested a small milk sample for compositional analysis. I hope that's all right.^^The chromatic proteins are unlike anything in the standard dairy literature. Thermo-reversible gel behavior. Exceptional emulsification index. The crystalline structure during freezing is, frankly, remarkable.^^The culinary implications demanded investigation. I've developed three recipes. The ice cream results are particularly compelling — I may have consumed more than the experimental protocol strictly required. For data integrity reasons.^^I look forward to comparing notes.^^  — Demetrius^ %item cookingRecipe Strawberry Ice Cream %%^ %item cookingRecipe Chocolate Ice Cream %%^ %item cookingRecipe Hot Chocolate %%[#]^Demetrius Pitches Ice Cream.
